name: shilp-sutra-smoke-consumer-next15
description: Minimal consumer smoke test for @devalok/shilp-sutra on Next.js 15 + Webpack. Scope is narrower than the Turbopack variant — install + import + build, no RichChatInput/tiptap-heavy surface. Catches the Webpack-specific CSS pipeline failures (PostCSS plugin resolution, @source directive handling) that Turbopack doesn't exercise.
